items.title: 🚨🆕 As soon as 16 y/o gem Niko Ilicevic turns 18, his contract will automatically convert into a professional deal valid
items.summary: 🚨🆕 As soon as 16 y/o gem Niko Ilicevic turns 18, his contract will automatically convert into a professional deal valid until at least 2031. There is NO release clause. His family would have liked one, but Markus Krösche refused to include it during the contract extension. Ilicevic is the youngest player in Bundesliga history alongside Youssoufa Moukoko. Despite extremely lucrative offers from top clubs, Ilicevic is planning to stay at Eintracht Frankfurt. #SGE @SkySportDE 🇩🇪🇭🇷
